exposure: Counselling on timely initiation of breastfeeding
Counselling provider (health professional vs. non-health professional)
outcome: Early initiation of breastfeeding (within 1 hour of birth)
cohort: 396 mother-newborn pairs in an urban and rural area of Bukavu, Democratic Republic of Congo
finding: Unmarried mothers, caesarean delivery, no counselling on timely initiation of breastfeeding, and counselling by a non-health professional were associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with delayed initiation of breastfeeding.
